title: Woodcarving a Seated Figure
content: This video (link to YouTube) shows how British sculptorGuy Reid(b. 1963) uses photographs shot at different angles to find the silhouettes of his sitting model. He cuts the shape out of wood with a band saw. Then he refines the 3D form with wood carving tools.The video itself is remarkable for the way it eschews voiceover and music, letting the visuals explain the process instead.
